name: Arendals Fossekompani ASA
summary: Arendals Fossekompani ASA, an industrial investment company, provides cyber secure satellite and mobile communications in Norway, Europe, Asia, and North America. It operates through AFK Vannkraft, Group Management, NSSL Global, ENRX, Tekna, AFK Eiendom, and Alytic segments. It offers voice and data services, and IT support services; and airtime, projects, hardware, and service to the maritime sector, the military and government sector, large international corporations, and the energy sector. The company also generates power through hydropower plants; and owns a portfolio of companies.
